external_side_effects: Downloaded public brand JPG assets for local design review.
Installed npm dependencies and Chromium for verification.
Google Fonts and on-demand Google Maps use external read-only requests.
No deployment, order, payment, email or social message was sent.

verification.evidence: Next.js 16.4.0 production compilation and TypeScript succeeded; all storefront routes and eight product pages generated.
tsc --noEmit returned no diagnostics; final build also checked the added tests.
8/8 passed after final source edits in 14.9 seconds on desktop/mobile Chromium. Initially missing Chromium was installed before verification.

verification.command: Inspect desktop/mobile home, desktop preview, product and store screenshots
verification.evidence: Real pie images loaded, responsive composition verified, and clipped footer wordmark corrected and rechecked.

residual_risks: No backend, live payment processing, authentication, inventory or administrator UI; checkout is explicitly a demonstration.
Operator confirmation needed for prices, seasonal availability, food labeling, pickup capacity and photo commercial usage permission.
Source photos are 1080px wide; very large displays can expose resolution limits.
External Google fonts/maps require network access; system fonts and official external directions links remain available.
Browser coverage uses Chromium desktop/mobile emulation, not physical Safari/Firefox devices.
